properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 947880 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: SIGNAL SHIP REPAIR, LLC
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 947880
Incident Time: 2010-07-15 22:45:00
Nearest City: Mobile, AL
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL, FUEL: NO. 2-D
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: SIGNAL SHIP REPAIR, LLC
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 4 feet by 50 feet (area 200 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 75 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
BARGE - 60' X 120' X 10' WITH DERRICK CRANE ON DECK. (FLOATING CRANE) AT APPROX. 1745 HOURS THE CRANE BARGE WAS OBSERVED AS LISTING TO THE OUTBOARD SIDE FROM THE BERTHING LOCATION AT SIGNAL'S YARD 3 BY THE ONSITE SECURITY GUARD. THE SECURITY GUARD NOTIFIED THE VICE PRESIDENT AND GENERAL MANAGER AND THEN IMMEDIATELY STARTED NOTIFYING ONSITE SUPERVISORS OF THE SITUATION. THE CRANE BARGE SANK AT THE DOCK APPROXIMATELY 75' WEST OF THE WEST MOBILE RIVER CHANNEL LINE TOE APPROXIMATELY 1/2 MILE SOUTH OF THE I-10 TUNNEL ALONG THE WEST BANK. EMERGENCY RESPONSE WAS PUT INTO ACTION. THE USCG WAS NOTIFIED, OIL RECOVERY COMPANY, INC. WAS CALLED TO PLACE CONTAINMENT BOOM AROUND THE VESSEL. KIM LEA DIVING AND SALVAGE WAS CALLED AND IS ON LOCATION MARKING THE EAST END OF THE BARGE AND CRANE RELATIVE TO THE CHANNEL. ALSO THE CAPTAIN OF THE PORT THE BARGE HAS APPROXIMATELY 75 GALLONS OF # 2 DIESEL FUEL - APPROXIMATELY 25 GALLONS OF ENGINE OIL AND APPROXIMATELY 40 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL ON BOARD THE CRANE. AT THIS POINT ALL THAT WAS NOTICED WAS A SLIGHT SHEEN ON THE WATER. THE SHEEN IS CONTAINED AND BEING CLEANED UP BY OIL RECOVERY COMPANY, INC..
